text: One connection flow lets you verify account ownership, ACH details, balances, and transactions

text: Real-time account balance lookup for underwriting or checking sufficient funds before an ACH debit
quote: Guaranteed live account balances. Used for underwriting or ensuring sufficient funds are available before submitting an ACH debit.

text: API exposes ledger transactions for a linked financial account
quote: The transactions API exposes the ledger transactions of a financial account.

text: Transactions list endpoint supports pagination controls
quote: the transactions list endpoint supports pagination controls.

text: Identity endpoint returns authorized accounts plus beneficial owner identity information
quote: Identity provides you with all of the accounts the end-user granted your application access authorization along with beneficial owner identity information for each of them.

text: Payments resource sends payments to self or a third party from the user's account via Zelle
quote: The payments resource allows you to send payments to yourself or a 3rd party on behalf of the end-user from their account. Currently the only supported payment scheme is Zelle

text: Supports a microdeposit-based flow to verify account details for institutions without instant connect
quote: To access account details from these institutions, you can implement the 'Verify Account Details via Microdeposit' flow.

text: Developers can register a webhook URL from the Teller Dashboard to receive callbacks

text: Webhook events are sent when enrollment or financial data conditions change
quote: Teller sends webhook events when specific conditions or changes are detected in user enrollments or their financial data.

text: Sandbox environment uses simulated data and never touches real institutions
quote: The sandbox environment uses simulated data and never connects to real financial institutions.

text: Sandbox supports an OTP MFA test flow with a documented fixed test code
quote: `otp` () - Will follow an OTP MFA flow whereby the user will be asked to select a contact to send an OTP code. The correct code is `0000`

text: Teller Connect is a documented, customizable hosted widget for linking accounts

text: Sidecar product lets you switch to Teller with a one-line config change

text: Instant connection to 7,000+ institutions with same-day ACH microdeposit fallback for others
quote: Connect instantly with more than 7,000 financial institutions and fall back to same-day ACH microdeposit verification for everyone else.

text: API authentication uses mTLS with client certificates issued by Teller
